scientific_role: strictly post-hoc Discovery-only mapping of immutable cross_person_alignment_fit trajectory families/geometry and continuous aligned local-state embeddings to subjective reports, context, and stimulus variables

immutable_source_boundary.state_branch_rule: cross_person_alignment_fit selected no stable shared discrete state family; use only the fixed continuous aligned-state embedding and never fabricate state families

mapping_population.trial_level: all 1,237 fixed cross_person_alignment_fit trajectories from all 31 eligible Discovery participants
mapping_population.state_level: all local states from the 19 participants with stable latent_state_fit within-person states; report values are attached to epoch observations only after policy lock
mapping_population.trial_to_state_weight: each of the three epoch observations in a trial receives weight 1/3 so every trial contributes total weight one

subjective_report_vector.interpretation: dimensions overlap but are not interchangeable; no single valence label substitutes for the full profile

nuisance_adjustment.primary_report_residualization: fit report ~ participant fixed effect + context + acquisition_fraction + acquisition_fraction_squared without any family/geometry/state predictor; use fold-contained fits for cross-validation and full-Discovery fits only for within-participant family contrasts
nuisance_adjustment.raw_descriptives: also report unadjusted family means and participant-level contrasts, explicitly labeled descriptive
nuisance_adjustment.emotion_category_not_a_nuisance_covariat: emotion_category is a mapping target and is never used to residualize reports

H1_trajectory_family_report_profile.statistic: shrinkage Hotelling-style quadratic statistic on the 31 participant-specific family-2 minus family-1 contrast vectors
H1_trajectory_family_report_profile.null: 10000 joint participant sign flips; the full 10-dimensional vector is flipped together
H1_trajectory_family_report_profile.effect_reporting: participant-bootstrap confidence intervals for the global norm and every report contrast

H2_continuous_geometry_incremental_repor.full_model: baseline plus all six fixed standardized trajectory-geometry coordinates
H2_continuous_geometry_incremental_repor.estimator: multivariate ridge; alpha selected only inside training participants from the prespecified ridge grid
H2_continuous_geometry_incremental_repor.outer_validation: fixed cross_person_fold, with no test-participant report calibration
H2_continuous_geometry_incremental_repor.global_metric: multivariate out-of-fold SSE improvement and variance-weighted Delta-R2 versus baseline
H2_continuous_geometry_incremental_repor.null: 1000 within-participant permutations of the entire 10-dimensional report row vector, preserving report covariance

H3_continuous_state_embedding_report_map.state_profile_construction: aggregate nuisance-adjusted trial report vectors to each local state with epoch weight 1/3, then occupancy-weight center state profiles within participant
H3_continuous_state_embedding_report_map.estimator: leave-one-participant-out multivariate ridge from the fixed aligned-state PCs to the 10-dimensional state report profile
H3_continuous_state_embedding_report_map.global_metric: held-out multivariate SSE improvement and variance-weighted Delta-R2
H3_continuous_state_embedding_report_map.null: 10000 within-participant permutations of complete state-profile vectors across that participant local states

H4_trajectory_family_context.statistic: participant-balanced normalized mutual information and Cramers V
H4_trajectory_family_context.null: 10000 within-participant family-label permutations preserving each participant family counts

H5_trajectory_family_emotion_category.analysis_set: all fixed trajectories with prespecified nonmissing emotion_category; no imputation and no exclusion from other hypotheses
H5_trajectory_family_emotion_category.statistic: participant-balanced normalized mutual information and Cramers V

H6_trajectory_family_stimulus_identity.analysis_set: all fixed trajectories with prespecified nonmissing stimulus_id; no imputation and no exclusion from other hypotheses

multiplicity_and_followups.report_followups: for H1, H2, or H3, report all 10 dimension-specific results; claim dimension-specific support only when the parent global hypothesis passes Holm and the 10 child p-values pass Holm within that parent
multiplicity_and_followups.core_reports: valence and liking remain explicitly identified but are not exempt from multiplicity control
multiplicity_and_followups.categorical_followups: cell residuals and category-specific proportions are descriptive only; no post-hoc category p-value fishing

effect_size_and_uncertainty.participant_balance: every participant has equal total weight in all trial-level statistics
effect_size_and_uncertainty.family_contrast_direction: family 2 minus family 1; labels are not renamed after mapping
effect_size_and_uncertainty.report_scale: original rating scale plus standardized effect size based on participant-level contrast SD

execution_order: verify cross_person_alignment_fit contract, authorization, branch decisions, and every final output hash
write and SHA-256 lock this complete mapping policy before opening reports/context/stimulus values
verify the prespecified primary_analysis_reference outcome-manifest hash and derivative_closure corrected layered-master hash
attach values one-to-one to fixed cross_person_alignment_fit trial IDs and latent_state_fit local-state epoch assignments
write immutable mapping manifests and source/missingness audits without calculating any association
mapping_inference may execute only the prespecified H1-H6 analyses and may not revise alignment or mapping design
forbidden: refitting cross_person_alignment_fit alignment after any report/context/stimulus value is opened
choosing family count, state count, embedding dimension, report subset, covariates, or test from observed mapping strength
renaming family 1/2 as positive, negative, pleasant, unpleasant, engaged, disengaged, or emotion categories before inference
dropping continuous-only participants or low-margin trials to improve association
globally dropping trials that lack prespecified stimulus identity; those rows remain in report/context hypotheses and are excluded only from the predeclared stimulus-target test
using report variables to alter any EEG preprocessing, PCA, GMM, state assignment, trajectory geometry, or family assignment
claim_guardrails: trajectory families are geometrical trajectory regimes, not emotion classes
a significant report association is post-hoc Discovery evidence and not independent validation
a null state-embedding mapping does not erase stable within-person states
context or stimulus association may explain part of report association and must be reported alongside it
Validation and Confirmation remain required for any generalization claim
